cases.title: Clicking Add note button creates and appends a new note
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Add note button creates a new note appended to the document body as a <div> element with the class "note" containing a visible, empty <textarea> with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports multiple rapid clicks on the Add note button, with each click creating a separate note containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Dynamic Markdown rendering in real-time
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") in real-time with proper HTML formatting and immediately reflected in local storage.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown syntax without crashing
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown syntax does not cause crashes or errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Create new note on page load and enter edit mode
cases.description: Verify that when the app page loads, clicking the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") creates a new note that immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), where view mode makes the main content area visible and hides the textarea, and edit mode reverses this behavior.

cases.title: Automatic saving to local storage during typing
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") on a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load Saved Notes and Default View Rendering
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates note elements with the correct classes and child components (tools div, edit and delete buttons, main div, and textarea), displays content in the main div, and hides the textarea by default for notes with content.

cases.title: Render Empty Notes with Visible Textarea
cases.description: Verify that for notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div, allowing immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle Empty LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage is empty when the Notes App webpage loads, no notes are shown.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit scenarios are fully covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing scenario gaps were identified.
All requirements and cases are fully covered, properly structured, and free of blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 contains multiple behaviors: clicking the Add note button creates a new note, appends it as a <div> with class "note", includes a visible empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea", and supports multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes each with its own textarea. It includes abnormal/error/boundary path for multiple rapid clicks. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: editing notes with Markdown rendering support, typing Markdown dynamically rendering in data-testid="note-main" in real-time with proper HTML formatting, handling complex Markdown syntax ensuring invalid Markdown does not cause crashes and displays raw input when exiting edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), and immediate reflection of changes in local storage. It includes edge/abnormal path for invalid Markdown syntax. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: page load creation via "Add note", entering edit mode upon creation with visible textarea and hidden main content area (data-testid="note-main"), switching between edit and view modes via "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), visibility states for view and edit modes, and automatic saving to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 describes deleting a note via "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button"), immediately removing it from the DOM, and removing the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 contains multiple behaviors: webpage load retrieval of saved notes from localStorage, dynamic creation of note divs with class note containing tools div, "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button"), main div (data-testid="note-main"), and textarea; rendering notes with content in main div with textarea hidden; showing textarea and hiding main div for notes with no content; handling empty localStorage with no notes shown; and internal retrieval via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')). It includes boundary conditions for empty localStorage and empty note content.
